text:
Hannah P: FYI from AE - prospect wants a single "Compliance+Burst" bundle: committed tokens, short-term high-burst window, on-prem validation hooks, and an explicit upgrade-to-dedicated path. asking product for a concise readiness checklist and pricing guardrails.

Luis G: quick pricing note - combining reserved + burst + on-prem shifts margin math. we should require a small non-refundable warm-node deposit if they want <48h upgrade. i'll sketch models for 3 burn cases.

Samir V: legal heads-up - no unlimited burst. recommend tiered burst bands with automatic throttling and a written exemption flow. liability capped to fees paid in prior 12 months. will draft an exhibit.

Nadia R: docs + AE enablement: need a 1-page entitlements grid and 3 example invoices (conservative/expected/high). also a short FAQ explaining the upgrade steps and what "on-prem validation" actually permits during a pilot.

Tom B: ops items: per-tenant telemetry at 1m granularity, alert when sustained >2x committed for >30m, feature-flag for the bundle, and a billing webhook to show remaining warm-hours/credits to AE. pre-warm nodes cost must be surfaced in the term sheet.

Hannah P: proposed launch-readiness checklist (v1):
1) pricing model (Luis) - include non-refundable warm deposit and surge rates
2) legal exhibit (Samir) - burst bands + exemption flow + liability cap
3) docs entitlements + invoice examples (Nadia)
4) ops feature-flag + telemetry + alert + billing webhook (Tom)
5) go/no-go sign-off by AE/Product/Legal (Hannah)

Luis G: i'll post three pricing sims by tomorrow afternoon. need committed RPS and avg tokens/request.

Hannah P: AE gave rough numbers: 200 RPS committed, peaks to 1k for short blasts, avg 550 tokens/req.

Tom B: creating feature-flag now: "compliance_burst_bundle" in staging. ops-bot: created flag owner=product default=false.

ops-bot: feature-flag "compliance_burst_bundle" created in staging. dashboard tile queued.

Samir V: drafting exhibit: suggest free burst up to 2x committed for 1h/day, then metered surge bands; exemptions require signed approval and an added deposit. will post draft in #legal by EOD.

Nadia R: I'll draft entitlements matrix and invoice examples and link to docs repo here. also a short AE script explaining upgrade path.

Hannah P: ok team — next steps: Luis (pricing sims), Samir (legal exhibit), Nadia (docs + AE script), Tom (flag + webhook). I'll schedule a 20m sign-off on Friday. Keep updates in-thread. :thumbsup:
